COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

3. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

4. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

5. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

7. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.

8. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.

11. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.

12. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer set up and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.

6. B — CPU

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.

9. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
